summary: AMPH carries multiple SEVERE and RED_FLAG findings: (1) FDA classified the South El Monte manufacturing facility as Official Action Indicated in April 2026, withheld from the Feb 26 2026 10-K despite the Dec 2025 inspection and Jan 2026 483 response being known; first disclosed in Q1 10-Q with minimization language. (2) BAQSIMI's growth narrative broke in Q1 2026 (-15% YoY on ASP collapse) against a $523.6M intangible. (3) Gross margin compressed 900bp in one quarter on flat revenue. (4) Product return reserves doubled on declining revenue (undisclosed/unexplained). (5) Form 4 evidence is diagnostic for SHORT-tier: zero code-P insider purchases over the 10-month window covering the -40% drawdown, while Director Petersen sold every month Aug-Dec 2025 at $25-31 (22,842 shares total) and corporate buyback transferred cash to selling insiders at $24-27. The honest disclosures (glucagon decline, jury verdict, liquidity) do not offset the omissions and Mode-B contradictions. Verdict: SHORT-tier candidate.
